title: console: a per-record bulk flow action counts runs the flow refused (status "refused") as succeeded, and shows only one of the refusal messages
body:
## Summary

On a list view whose `bulkActions` names a `type: 'flow'` action in the bare-string form (per-record dispatch), the selection bar's result dialog counts a run that the flow **refused** as a success. A flow that ends on an `end` node with `outcome: 'refused'` answers `200` with `data.status: "refused"` and a `refusalMessage`; the bulk result still reads "Succeeded N / N" and lists the refused rows as done. In the same run only **one** refusal dialog is shown, whichever refused row it belongs to; the other refused rows' reasons are never displayed.

The same action launched from a row menu behaves correctly: the refusal dialog replaces the success toast.

## Environment

- `@objectstack/*` 18.6.0, console at `/_console`, zh-CN locale (same in en)
- App: HotCRM 6.6.0 (`objectstack-ai/hotcrm`), action `create_campaign` on `crm_lead` (`type: 'flow'`, `target: 'campaign_lead_member_enroll'`, `recordIdParam: 'leadId'`, one lookup param), wired as `bulkActions: ['create_campaign']` on the All Leads grid

## Steps

1. Open the leads list, tick three leads: two with `email_opt_out = true`, one without.
2. Selection bar → **Add to Campaign**, pick an open campaign, Next, confirm the three listed records, **Run**.

## Actual

Three `POST /api/v1/actions/crm_lead/create_campaign` calls, all `200`:

```jsonc
// two of them
{"success":true,"data":{"success":true,"status":"refused",
  "refusalMessage":"<lead name> has opted out of email, so the lead was not added to the campaign.",
  "output":{"enrolled":false,"addedCount":0,"alreadyCount":0}, ...}}
// one of them
{"success":true,"data":{"success":true,
  "output":{"enrolled":true,"campaignName":"…","addedCount":1,"alreadyCount":0}, ...}}
```

The console then shows two dialogs at once:

- the bulk result dialog: **"Succeeded 3 / 3"**, listing all three leads;
- on top of it, one refusal dialog with the message of **one** of the two refused leads.

Closing the refusal dialog does not reveal a second one. One member row was created, not three. With a single opted-out lead selected the result reads "Succeeded 1 / 1" next to a dialog that says the lead was not added.

## Expected

- A per-record dispatch whose response carries `status: "refused"` is not counted as succeeded. The result dialog reports it apart (for example "1 succeeded, 2 refused") and shows each refused row with its own `refusalMessage`.
- No separate refusal dialog is stacked on the result dialog; or, if one is kept, it carries every refused row's message.

## Why it matters

The user reads "Succeeded 3 / 3" and takes the whole selection as enrolled. The one refusal they are shown names one person, so the other refused people are lost silently. Any app that puts a gate in a flow as an `outcome: 'refused'` end (the documented way to refuse with per-record text, #14945) gets a wrong count on the bulk door.

Related: #34269 fixed the same symptom for the **aggregate** contract (`BulkActionResult` dropped, all rows reported succeeded). This is the per-record fan-out contract, where each call's own `status` is the per-row verdict.
